brief: Build a gentle salt-marsh sample carrier. Use the artist's drawn Walking legs value as the exact total count of individual load-bearing legs. Give each leg its own sweep region with motionRole thigh, attached to the protected body, and an individual terminal foot with motionRole foot. The feet rest on the ground. Keep the core at its current position. Give it a readable head, one small sample pouch and an original ecology. Use the other cues where space permits.

trials.summary: A gentle three-legged salt-marsh carrier with a tall billed head, branching salt-sensing crest and one small sample pouch; it gathers shed reed seeds while its broad feet aerate the mud.
A gentle eight-legged brinewalker with a tall reed neck, painted long-billed head, branching tide antenna and one small pouch for carrying salt-marsh seeds between isolated pools.
